author: Swinhoe, 1861
habitat: 나무 위, 잎이 적은 가지나 마른 가지
summary: 봄과 가을에 한반도 전역을 드물지 않게 지나가는 나그네새이다. 홀로 또는 암수가 함께 늘 나무 위에서 지내며, 잎이 적은 가지 끝이나 마른 가지에 몸을 곧추세우고 앉는다. 딱정벌레목·벌목·파리목·매미목·메뚜기목 곤충을 주로 먹는다. 구북구 동부, 캄차카, 쿠릴 열도, 사할린, 아무르 하류, 우수리, 만주 등지에서 번식하고 필리핀, 셀레베스, 몰루카, 뉴기니 서북부 등지에서 겨울을 난다.

points.en: dark brownish-grey crown with dark shaft streaks
bill forming an isosceles triangle from above
small blackish-brown legs with large claws

sexes.text: 암수가 매우 비슷해 깃털로는 구별할 수 없다.

art.subject: Grey-streaked Flycatcher (Muscicapa griseisticta), adult on passage (sexes alike): forehead and crown dark brownish-grey with fine dark shaft streaks; lores pale grey; a narrow whitish eye-ring; ear-coverts and cheeks mixed pale grey and brownish-grey; a thin dark malar line; upperparts dark brownish-grey; wings dark brown with a narrow whitish wing-bar and pale-edged tertials; tail dark brown; throat white; breast and flanks white with crisp, dark grey-brown streaks; belly and undertail coverts clean white; bill blackish-brown with a pale base to the lower mandible; brown eye; short blackish-brown legs.
art.pose: perched bolt upright on a bare dead branch near the treetop
art.scene: Korean woodland during spring or autumn migration, sparse-leaved branches at the top of a tree; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched upright on a bare twig: dark brownish-grey upperparts and streaked crown, pale grey lores, white underparts with crisp dark grey-brown streaks on breast and flanks, long wings reaching near the tail tip, dark brown tail, blackish-brown legs
adult, head seen from above: broad flat bill forming an isosceles triangle, dark brownish-grey crown with fine dark shaft streaks, pale grey lores
art.build: Small, upright flycatcher, about 13cm — about sparrow length but slimmer and longer-winged. Big rounded head and short neck. Bill short and flat, very broad at the base so that it forms an isosceles triangle seen from above. Legs short, blackish-brown, with relatively large claws. Wings very long: at rest the primary tips reach close to the tail tip. Tail medium-length and square. Sits bolt upright on bare dead twigs at the tops of trees and sallies out after flying insects, returning to the same perch.
avoid: Do not leave the underparts plain; crisp dark streaks on the white breast and flanks separate it from Asian Brown Flycatcher (Muscicapa dauurica).
Do not paint a smudgy brown breast wash and pale half-collar — that is Dark-sided Flycatcher (Muscicapa sibirica).
Do not paint short wings; the primaries reach close to the tail tip.
Do not paint pale or pinkish legs.
